{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.68

|arg= global

|eff= local

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Enable/disable object as a feature/landmark. Possible feature types:
* 0 - Feature disabled
* 1 - Object is always visible within object view distance
* 2 - Object is always visible within terrain view distance

{{Feature|important|
The limit is '''500''' map/static objects and '''200''' dynamic objects including config features and auto features (flying helicopters, airplanes).<br>
The command returns [[false]] if the related limit is reached.
}}

|s1= object [[setFeatureType]] type

|p1= object: [[Object]]

|p2= type: [[Number]] - the desired feature type

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] if the feature is set, [[false]] otherwise (limit reached)

|x1= Set a building to be always rendered:
<sqf>building setFeatureType 2;</sqf>

|seealso= [[setViewDistance]] [[setObjectViewDistance]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Waffle SS.
|timestamp= 20171010161800
|text= For world objects, command effect persists '''after mission restart'''. Map must be reloaded to automatically revert setting.
}}
